name: Hellish Rebuke

header.Casting Time: Reaction, which you take in response to taking damage from a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.casting_time: Reaction, which you take in response to taking damage from a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself

authored_intent: Reaction to damage by seen creature within 60 feet; qualifying creature makes DEX save for half Fire; higher slots add dice; source damage occurrence and payment remain exact.

rules.text: The creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by green flames.
It makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.
